newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Merchants rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Merchants rated buy.

text.p: --Chicago Corp said Wednesday it initiated coverage of First Merchants Acceptance Corp with a buy rating.
--It said it has a nine to 12 month price target on the specialty finance company's stock of $34.

--First Merchants currently focuses on sub prime auto financing, but Chicago Corp said it expects the company to move into at least two new segments over the next six months, with resulting earnings that could be material to 1998 results.
--Chicago Corp's EPS estimates for Deerfield, Ill.-based First Merchants are $1.91 for 1996 and $2.30 for 1997.
